title: Hyperposition H3 Epoch-Pinned Adaptive Topology Compiler
summary: H3 refines HYP-RC2 into HYP-RC3: canonical n-ary semantics compile into immutable semantic epochs, transient activation epochs, basis-pinned Assemblies, independently versioned coordination/locality topologies, and adaptive incremental/partial/full rematerialization. A TopologyBasis witness binds semantic epoch, activation epoch, CognitiveFrame and operation/projection semantics for replay and causal attribution.
key_negative_results: activation can preserve revoked support across semantic epochs
pairwise expansion can create false associative paths
unbounded higher-order diffusion is not an optimization target
open_questions: Do mixed-basis candidates occur in live FRANK/ClayGraph?
Does truthful sparse latent activation causally improve target-4B next decisions under matched visible information?
Can a live adaptive rematerialization controller approach the measured oracle without instability?
Which higher-order queries admit safe pairwise projections?
